user.title: Connect to your Unsloth model server
user.description: Enter the OpenAI-compatible base URL of your inference server (ending in /v1). The available models are read from it in the next step.

model.title: Choose a model
model.description: {count} model(s) reported by the server. You can also type a name that isn't listed.
